name: Turlassil

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: What've we got here? An audience?
dialogue.trigger: When you enter the Bloodsport Arena:

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: Fresh challengers more like.
dialogue.trigger: When you enter the Bloodsport Arena:

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: Shame the usual crowd isn't here to watch us slaughter them.
dialogue.trigger: When you enter the Bloodsport Arena:

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: Their screams will have to substitute for cheering.
dialogue.trigger: When you enter the Bloodsport Arena:

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: Let's put on a show!
dialogue.trigger: When you enter the Bloodsport Arena:

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: That's the spirit! Let's make this a grand melee!

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: Oh, look, they're grandstanding. We'll have to humble them.

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: Care to wager how long they last?

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: I wager half will be dead before three beats of a drum.

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: If memory serves me, there's typically more fighting involved when defending against an invasion, correct?

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: You down there. Puny one. Go on and jump off the platform. You won't do.

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: If you can't manage this, we won't bother getting up.

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: They're a bore, brother. I don't think we're even going to get a warmup out of this.

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: Ly, I believe they're frozen with fright.

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: Let the games begin!

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: You pass. Barely.
dialogue.trigger: After defeating the first wave of wolves:

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: You looked a little too eager to kill our hounds for my taste.
dialogue.trigger: After defeating the first wave of wolves:

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: That was just a taste of what's to come.
dialogue.trigger: After defeating the first wave of wolves:

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: Don't get up, Ly. This will just be a moment.
dialogue.trigger: If he's the first one to face:

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: I'll take the first round, Ly.
dialogue.trigger: If he's the first one to face:

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: You're not prepared to wield my power.

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: How dare you tap into my power.

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: Letting the cold in will only see you freeze.

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: You shouldn't have taken what wasn't yours.
dialogue.trigger: Turlassil taking the Piecing Hailstone in Frigidarium (Hard Mode only):

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: Ice and frost, obey my command.

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: How do you like my ice sculpture?

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: Your turn, atronach. Liven up the show. Well, the opposite of that.

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: I may be down, but not out.
dialogue.trigger: Summoning Ice Atronarch to aid Lylanar (Hard Mode only):

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: Chilling, isn't it?

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: Just about ready to shatter.

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: You'll be quick to freeze like that.

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: You're ready to learn what piercing cold really means.

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: Don't think I won't exploit such an obvious weakness.

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: My hounds are as cold-hearted as I am.

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: Hounds! Earn your dinner!

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: Let my hounds icey teeth numb the pain!

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: A few more hounds should spice up this fight.

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: Keep these rats from nipping at my heels for a moment Ly.

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: I thought you'd never ask.

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: Enough! Tie and anchor to these vermin Ly.

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: Of course. But you owe me.

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: I don't want to finish them off before you get a crack at them Ly.

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: Allow me to demonstrate what winning looks like.

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: That was a limp performance, Turli. I'll show them what true power is.

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: You'll be crying for my help soon enough.

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: Make good use of this warm up. You'll need it.

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: Watch me, Turli. This is how it's done!

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: I may be down, but not out!

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: One good spark should set you off.

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: Whew, I might have underestimated them a tad.

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: I'm always cleaning up after you Ly.

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: Clip their wings for me, Turli! I'll handle the rest.

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: Anything for my dear brother.

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: Boooring! I'll add to the side show.

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: You're stronger than you look, but this ends now! Slow them down, Turli.

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: It warms me to feed needed.

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: I don't wish to hog all the excitement. Turli, why don't you get in on the action?

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: It would seem my bad luck has rubbed off on you, Ly.
dialogue.trigger: When both brothers are out in the arena:

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: Enough heckling from the stands! Let's put an end to this together.
dialogue.trigger: When both brothers are out in the arena:

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: Now, Ly!
dialogue.trigger: When the brothers combining their attacks:

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: A duet of death!
dialogue.trigger: When the brothers combining their attacks:

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: Join me, brother!
dialogue.trigger: When the brothers combining their attacks:

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: Combined might!
dialogue.trigger: When the brothers combining their attacks:

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: Join me, brother!
dialogue.trigger: When the brothers combining their attacks:

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: Time for the finale!
dialogue.trigger: When the brothers combining their attacks:

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: Let's team up a while
dialogue.trigger: When the brothers combining their attacks:

dialogue.speaker: Lylanar
dialogue.line: Let's finish this!
dialogue.trigger: When the brothers combining their attacks:

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: Shame there wasn't an audience for this victory.

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: Undefeated versus Undaunted. This outcome was inevitable.

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: Another victory for the reigning champions!

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: An easy kill.

dialogue.speaker: Turlassil
dialogue.line: Your skills are weak.
"At least we go together …."

notes: He wears the Rainsiren Nereid skin and Cracked Mud Tattoos body markings.
He is referred to as "meaty" by a Bosmer who wishes to eat him.
related_quests: Reavers of the Reef: Drive the Dreadsail pirates from the Systres.
summary: Turlassil (or Turli) is a blue striped Maormer found in Dreadsail Reef. He is the twin brother of Lylanar and both serve as the first boss of the trial.
